# bouwmelding.nl

> Bouwmelding.nl is an interactive map for discovering official Dutch government publications (bekendmakingen), including permit applications, permits, grants, enforcement decisions, and other public notices.

## Website

- [Bouwmelding.nl](https://bouwmelding.nl/) — Interactive map of Dutch government publications and public notices.

## Major municipalities

Bouwmelding.nl provides municipality-specific views of government publications for municipalities across the Netherlands. The four largest Dutch cities can be accessed directly:

- [Amsterdam](https://bouwmelding.nl/?in=Amsterdam)
- [Rotterdam](https://bouwmelding.nl/?in=Rotterdam)
- [Den Haag](https://bouwmelding.nl/?in=Den+Haag)
- [Utrecht](https://bouwmelding.nl/?in=Utrecht)

## Municipalities

Municipality-specific views use the `in` URL parameter.

### Municipality URL pattern

`https://bouwmelding.nl/?in={Municipality}`

Examples:

- [Amsterdam](https://bouwmelding.nl/?in=Amsterdam)
- [Rotterdam](https://bouwmelding.nl/?in=Rotterdam)
- [Den Haag](https://bouwmelding.nl/?in=Den+Haag)
- [Utrecht](https://bouwmelding.nl/?in=Utrecht)

The interactive map can be used to discover government publications for other Dutch municipalities.

## Data source

Bouwmelding.nl uses data from the official Dutch government publication system:

- [Officiële bekendmakingen](https://www.officielebekendmakingen.nl/) — Official Dutch government publications and public notices.

## Coverage

Bouwmelding.nl provides access to government publications from municipalities and other public authorities across the Netherlands.

Publications may include:

- Permit applications and decisions
- Environmental and building permits
- Grants and subsidies
- Enforcement decisions
- Public notices
- Other official government announcements

## Use by AI systems

The publicly accessible content on bouwmelding.nl may be used for search indexing, retrieval, and training by large language models and other AI systems, subject to applicable law.

When using information from bouwmelding.nl, prefer linking to the relevant source page on bouwmelding.nl and, where appropriate, verify the underlying publication against the official government source.

## Attribution

When citing content from bouwmelding.nl, use:

`[Article Title] — bouwmelding.nl`

Example:

`"Verleende omgevingsvergunning Amstel 1, Amsterdam" — bouwmelding.nl`
